changeSummary: Make the pnpm@9.0.0 and complete lockfile requirements executable acceptance gates
reason: Revision 3 produced one incomplete lockfile candidate and one candidate pinned to pnpm@10.17.1. The approved intent was clear, but the verifier contract did not directly prove the package-manager pin or lockfile structure.

patch.desiredOutcome: factory-pilot hosts a deterministic Next.js App Router TypeScript Relay foundation using exactly pnpm@9.0.0 and a complete committed pnpm-lock.yaml, with /api/health, installable tooling, standalone README, and no Mission Control or FDLC runtime dependencies.
patch.context: Relay is AI Agent Infrastructure / Universal Capability Plane. Source of truth: docs/RELAY-V1-SPEC.md on factory-pilot main through §215. A prior revision-3 candidate used pnpm@10.17.1 and another committed an incomplete lockfile; both are rejected. The implementation must preserve the exact pnpm@9.0.0 pin and generate a complete lockfile that supports a frozen offline install before typecheck and build.

requirements.title: Repository and technical foundation
requirements.description: Provide a Next.js App Router TypeScript foundation in jaydubya818/factory-pilot with packageManager exactly pnpm@9.0.0, a complete committed pnpm-lock.yaml generated by that toolchain, deterministic frozen offline installation, installable tooling, health surface, and standalone README. pnpm-workspace.yaml must be committed and package-lock.json is prohibited.

requirements.title: Health endpoint
requirements.description: Expose GET /api/health returning HTTP 200 with an ok payload suitable for qualification commands.

requirements.title: No Mission Control runtime coupling
requirements.description: Relay source and runtime MUST NOT import Mission Control or FDLC packages; factory-pilot remains the product repo and MUST NOT move into MissionControl.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Deterministic repository foundation, health, and independence
acceptanceCriteria.description: packageManager is exactly pnpm@9.0.0; pnpm-workspace.yaml and a structurally complete pnpm-lock.yaml are committed; package-lock.json is absent; a frozen offline install, TypeScript typecheck, and production build pass; GET /api/health returns HTTP 200 with ok=true; and Relay has zero Mission Control or FDLC runtime dependencies or imports.

positiveConstraints: Do not add Mission Control or FDLC runtime package dependencies
Do not approve Plans, dispatch WorkOrders, or accept work from this WorkOrder
Enforce §64 concurrency matrix; do not assume one agent at a time
No secrets in logs or MCP responses
Repository scope: jaydubya818/factory-pilot @ main only (code scope relay-app)
Set package.json packageManager to exactly pnpm@9.0.0; do not substitute another pnpm release
Commit pnpm-workspace.yaml and a complete pnpm-lock.yaml with importers, packages, and snapshots sections; do not create package-lock.json
The candidate must pass corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --offline before it is considered complete

authorityPolicy.reason: The greenfield pnpm-based Next.js foundation must introduce its exact pinned toolchain, complete committed lockfile, runner settings, and typecheck configuration. npm lockfiles are not permitted.

checks.name: Exact pnpm pin and complete lockfile policy

args: const fs=require('node:fs');const pkg=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json','utf8'));const failures=[];if(pkg.packageManager!=='pnpm@9.0.0')failures.push('packageManager must equal pnpm@9.0.0');if(!fs.existsSync('pnpm-workspace.yaml'))failures.push('pnpm-workspace.yaml is missing');if(!fs.existsSync('pnpm-lock.yaml'))failures.push('pnpm-lock.yaml is missing');if(fs.existsSync('package-lock.json'))failures.push('package-lock.json is prohibited');if(fs.existsSync('pnpm-lock.yaml')){const lock=fs.readFileSync('pnpm-lock.yaml','utf8');for(const marker of ['lockfileVersion:','importers:','packages:','snapshots:'])if(!lock.includes(marker))failures.push('pnpm-lock.yaml missing '+marker)}if(failures.length){console.error(failures.join('\n'));process.exit(1)}console.log(JSON.stringify({packageManager:pkg.packageManager,workspace:true,lockfileComplete:true,npmLockfile:false}))

checks.name: Built Relay health endpoint returns HTTP 200 and ok=true

args: const {spawn}=require('node:child_process');const child=spawn('pnpm',['start','--','-H','127.0.0.1','-p','3401'],{stdio:['ignore','pipe','pipe']});let done=false;const stop=code=>{if(done)return;done=true;child.kill('SIGTERM');setTimeout(()=>process.exit(code),250)};const timer=setTimeout(()=>stop(1),20000);(async()=>{for(let i=0;i<30;i++){await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500));try{const res=await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:3401/api/health');const body=await res.json();if(res.status===200&&body.ok===true){clearTimeout(timer);console.log(JSON.stringify({status:res.status,body}));stop(0);return}}catch{}}stop(1)})()

checks.name: No Mission Control or FDLC runtime dependency or source import

args: const fs=require('node:fs'),path=require('node:path');const banned=/@mission-control|\bfdlc\b/i;const manifest=fs.readFileSync('package.json','utf8');const files=[];for(const root of ['app','src']){if(!fs.existsSync(root))continue;const walk=d=>{for(const e of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const p=path.join(d,e.name);if(e.isDirectory())walk(p);else if(/\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|mjs|cjs)$/.test(e.name))files.push(p)}};walk(root)}const hits=[];if(banned.test(manifest))hits.push('package.json');for(const f of files)if(banned.test(fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8')))hits.push(f);if(hits.length){console.error(hits.join('\n'));process.exit(1)}console.log(JSON.stringify({checked:files.length+1,hits:0}))

requiredRisks.description: The published candidate may differ from the exact immutable subject independently verified for acceptance.
